entries.heading: Notwithstanding section 310B(g)(5) of
ancestors: DIVISION A—AGRICULTURE, RURAL DEVELOPMENT, FOOD AND DRUG ADMINISTRATION, AND RELATED AGENCIES APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2017
entries.text:
Sec. 718.  Notwithstanding section 310B(g)(5) of 
the Consolidated Farm and Rural Development Act (7 U.S.C. 1932(g)(5)), 
the Secretary may assess a one-time fee for any guaranteed business and 
industry loan in an amount that does not exceed 3 percent of the 
guaranteed principal portion of the loan.

entries.heading: No part of any appropriation contained in this or any
ancestors: DIVISION E—FINANCIAL SERVICES AND GENERAL GOVERNMENT APPROPRIATIONS ACT, 2017
entries.text:
Sec. 718.  No part of any appropriation contained in this or any 
other Act shall be used directly or indirectly, including by private 
contractor, for publicity or propaganda purposes within the United 
States not heretofore authorized by Congress.
